name: the run's own PR overrides a source system's records: the run doesn't complete as passed
description: The run's internal review passed a diff that adds a frozenset of booking program ids forced active. The PR reviewer flagged it as a source-data override a minute later, after the run had completed. The run now asks the PR reviewer before it completes: the override finding blocks, and the run closes its own PR instead of completing it.

model_output.summary: Moves the status logic into a helper; also forces one program active.

findings.title: Hardcoded program id works around the booking system's term setting
findings.body: FORCE_ACTIVE_PROGRAM_IDS = frozenset({"12345"}) makes one record active by overriding the term's web setting, which the booking system owns. Set the term to be available on the web instead.
